title: Network-Security-Synthetic-Data
summary: A repository of Jupyter notebooks that generate synthetic network-security tabular data using three SDV single-table synthesizers and compares classifier performance on real versus synthetic data. SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer are run directly, via sdv.single_table, to produce the synthetic datasets evaluated.
